correctness.rationale: Set b=1/lambda in [1,5/3]. Five contributing quadratic spline samples yield Im(Z)/sin(theta)=Delta_1+2Delta_2 cos(theta), bounded below by D_b=Delta_1-2Delta_2. The piecewise quadratic spline second derivatives give D_b concave on x in [0,1/2], with D_b(0)=0 and D_b(1/2)=(-21b²+54b-29)/(8b²)>0, hence positive away from x=0. On x=0, the cosine polynomial P_b(t) is nondecreasing and P_b(-1)>0; on nu=0, Z>0; the nu=1/2 boundary R_b(x) is strictly decreasing to its symmetry zero at x=1/2. Under b>5/3 published aliasing gives positive-length half-frequency zero interval. Independently checked 931 exact rational configurations for b from 1 to 5/3 and b in 7/4,15/8,2; those tests are supplementary to analytic continuum inequalities.
